name: WebPlanet AI Content Gen
author: webplanetsoft

sections.description:
WebPlanet AI Content Gen allows you to generate unlimited, high-quality blog posts manually using the power of Google Gemini AI (Free Tier).

Stop staring at a blank screen. Just enter a topic, and our plugin generates an SEO-optimized article with proper headings, introduction, and conclusion instantly.

Third-Party Service Disclosure:
This plugin uses the Google Gemini API to generate content.
* Service: Google Gemini (Generative AI)
* Terms of Use: Google Generative AI Terms
* Privacy Policy: Google Privacy Policy
* Data Sent: The “Topic” you enter in the generator is sent to Google’s servers to generate the text. No other site data is shared.

✨ Lite Features (Free Forever)

  • Unlimited Manual Generation: Type a topic, get a blog post instantly.
  • Gemini 1.5 Flash Integration: Uses the latest efficient Google AI model.
  • Smart Word Count: Adjustable word count from 50 to 1500 words.
  • SEO Native: Automatically fills Yoast SEO & RankMath titles and meta descriptions.
  • Draft Review: Saves content as a “Draft” so you can review visually before publishing.
  • Standard Editor: Uses the native WordPress editor for a familiar experience.

🚀 Upgrade to PRO (Coming Soon)

Unlock the full potential of AI automation directly from your dashboard settings:
* ✅ Unlock ChatGPT: Switch between Google Gemini and OpenAI’s ChatGPT.
* ✅ Auto-Scheduler: Set it to “Automatic Mode” to publish articles while you sleep.
* ✅ Custom Post Types: Generate content for Products, Real Estate listings, and more.
* ✅ AI Feature Images: Automatically create and attach relevant images to every post.
* ✅ Category Selection: Choose specific categories for your AI content.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the webplanet-ai-content-gen folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate via ‘Plugins’ menu.
  3. Go to AI Content Gen > Settings in your WordPress dashboard.
  4. Enter your Google Gemini API Key (A free key works perfectly).
  5. Go to AI Content Gen > Generate Content to start writing!
